use codegen_runtime::{FunctionError, Instance, OwnedSourceLimits, RuntimeError, Value};
use serde_json::{Value as Json, json};

fn from_json(value: &Json) -> Instance {
    match value {
        Json::Object(fields) => Instance::Group(
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), from_json(v)))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .into(),
        ),
        Json::Array(items) => Instance::Repeated(items.iter().map(from_json).collect()),
        Json::String(value) => Instance::Scalar(Value::String(value.clone())),
        Json::Bool(value) => Instance::Scalar(Value::Bool(*value)),
        Json::Null => Instance::Scalar(Value::Null),
        _ => panic!("unexpected authored input kind"),
    }
}
fn to_json(value: &Instance) -> Json {
    match value {
        Instance::Group(fields) => Json::Object(
            fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), to_json(v)))
                .collect(),
        ),
        Instance::Repeated(items) | Instance::MappedSequence(items) => {
            Json::Array(items.iter().map(to_json).collect())
        }
        Instance::Scalar(Value::String(value)) => json!(value),
        Instance::Scalar(Value::Bool(value)) => json!(value),
        Instance::Scalar(Value::Null) => Json::Null,
        _ => panic!("unexpected generated output kind"),
    }
}
fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let path = std::env::args().nth(1).ok_or("need cases path")?;
    let cases: Json = serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(&path)?)?;
    let mut evidence = Vec::new();
    for case in cases.as_array().ok_or("need cases array")? {
        let source = from_json(&case["input"]);
        let limits = OwnedSourceLimits {
            max_roots: 4,
            max_active_frames: 32,
            max_path_segments: 64,
            max_metadata_bytes: 1_048_576,
            max_walk_contexts: 4096,
        };
        let actual =
            mfd051_scalar_candidate::execute_with_basic_owned_sources(&source, &[], None, limits);
        let observed = match actual {
            Ok(output) => json!({"output": to_json(&output.primary)}),
            Err(RuntimeError::MappingException {
                message: Some(message),
                ..
            }) if message == "required source field is absent" => json!({"error": "required"}),
            Err(RuntimeError::Function(FunctionError::InvalidArgument {
                function: "format_guid_string",
                ..
            })) => json!({"error": "guid"}),
            Err(error) => {
                return Err(format!("{}: unexpected error {error:?}", case["label"]).into());
            }
        };
        let wanted = if case.get("error").is_some() {
            json!({"error": case["error"]})
        } else {
            json!({"output": case["expected"]})
        };
        evidence.push(json!({"label":case["label"], "actual":observed, "expected":wanted}));
        if observed != wanted {
            return Err(format!("mismatch: {}", evidence.last().unwrap()).into());
        }
    }
    std::fs::write(
        format!("{path}.rust-results.json"),
        serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&evidence)?,
    )?;
    println!("{} generated Rust cases passed", evidence.len());
    Ok(())
}
